product.description:
Product Description

Introducing the Electric Scalp Massager Hair Oil Applicator—designed to help you apply hair oils, essential oils, or nutrient solutions precisely where you need them. With 3 vibration modes, a 6ML storage tank, and waterproof design, this applicator will enhance your scalp health and absorption of hair products with ease.

💆‍♀️ Why You’ll Love It:

✅ Precision Application – Delivers oil directly to the root for even distribution.
✅ Soothing Scalp Massage – High-frequency vibration massage promotes absorption while relaxing the scalp.
✅ Durable & Safe – Made of TPU and PCTG materials for corrosion resistance and no chemical reaction with liquid products.
✅ Waterproof & Easy to Clean – IPX5 waterproof design for easy rinsing after use.
✅ Portable & Convenient – Compact size with a Type-C charging cable for easy charging and travel.

⚙️ Features

🎯 3 Vibration Modes – High-frequency vibration to massage and stimulate the scalp for better hair growth and absorption.
💧 Clear Scale Storage – The 6ML storage box helps measure the right dosage (1ML) for accurate application without waste.
🌊 Waterproof Design – Rinse the applicator directly after use to keep it clean and hygienic.
🔋 Long-Lasting Battery – Fully charged in one hour, lasts up to 5 days on a single charge.
🌿 Versatile Use – Suitable for minoxidil, conditioner, nutrient solutions, and essential oils.

🔧 Maintenance Instructions

✔️ Regular Cleaning – Rinse the applicator with water after use to prevent clogging and maintain hygiene.
✔️ Avoid Viscous Oils – Best used with aqueous liquid oils, not suitable for high concentration or viscous oils.
✔️ Proper Storage – Keep it dry and clean after use to extend the product’s lifespan.

🚫 Warning
🚫 Do not submerge the applicator in water for prolonged periods.
🚫 Clean the applicator immediately after use to avoid clogging the nozzle.

📏 Specifications

🔋 Battery: Lithium Ion (included)
📦 Package Includes:
✔️ 1 × Electric Scalp Massager Hair Oil Applicator

🧽 🫧 Foam Spray Cleaner for Kitchen — Product Description

Make kitchen cleaning effortless with this powerful foam spray cleaner designed to remove stubborn grease, oil, and food residue. Its thick foam formula clings to surfaces, breaking down buildup instantly so you can wipe it away with ease — no heavy scrubbing required.

✨ Key Features

  • Active Foam Technology — Rich foam sticks to vertical and hard-to-reach surfaces for deeper cleaning

  • Powerful Degreasing — Cuts through tough grease, burnt oil, and sticky residues

  • Multi-Surface Safe — Suitable for stainless steel, stovetops, range hoods, tiles, and countertops

  • Quick & Easy Use — Spray → wait → wipe clean

  • Leaves Surfaces Fresh & Shiny

🏠 Ideal For

  • Kitchen hoods & filters

  • Gas stoves & burners

  • Ovens & microwave exteriors

  • Tiles, sinks, and metal surfaces

🛠️ How to Use
1️⃣ Shake can well
2️⃣ Spray foam onto dirty surface
3️⃣ Let sit for 30–60 seconds
4️⃣ Wipe clean with cloth or sponge

⚠️ Safety

  • Avoid eye/skin contact

  • Use in ventilated area

  • Keep away from children

  • Test on small area before full use

product.description:
Lanbena Nose About Product

LANBENA Plants Pore Strips are designed to deeply cleanse the pores and remove impurities and blackheads. 

These strips are enriched with natural plant-based ingredients aimed at reducing pore size and purifying the skin. 

They help absorb excess oils and unclog blocked pores, promoting a clearer and healthier complexion.

 The formula is gentle on the skin, causing no irritation, making them suitable for daily or regular use       

Description

  • Method of Using LANBENA Mask:
  • Cleanse your skin thoroughly with warm water.
  • Apply a layer of the mask to the targeted area (nose, forehead, chin).
  • Place the designated paper sheet over the applied mask.
  • Wait for 10-15 minutes until the mask is completely dry.
  • Gently peel off the paper sheet.
  • Important Note:
  • Heat: If the mask is frozen, place it in a container with hot water for 10 minutes before use.
